messages.author: d41b7a8b0ed903de
messages.subject: logTrans=FALSE command
parts:
Greetings,

Is there a way to prevent the function dataProcess from converting my values to log2 or 10 transformed? Currently, I am already using a input data that has been log2 transformed.

Regards,
Parthiban

messages.author: 13904eb0f06097b0
messages.subject: Re: logTrans=FALSE command
parts:
Hi Parthiban,

There is no way to prevent the log transformation, but you can simply transform them back to the original scale before input into the dataProcess fuction (e.g. input$Intensity = 2^input$Intensity)

Best,
Devon
